    parser.add_argument("mode", choices=("save", "check", "compare"))
    parser.add_argument("names", nargs="+")
    parser.add_argument("--dir", type=Path, default=D)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    args.dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.mode == "save":
        name = args.names[0]
        payload = collect()
        (args.dir / f"{name}.json").write_text(json.dumps(payload))
        print(f"  saved {args.dir / name}.json")
        for key, row in payload.items():
            print(
                f"    {key:14s} local={row['prompt_tokens']:6d} "
                f"server={row['server_prompt_tokens']:6d} "
                f"forced={row['forced_prompt_tokens']:6d} "
                f"({row['forced_tokens']} scored tokens)"
"    LOGPROB_MAX={overall['max']:.6f} LOGPROB_MEAN={overall['mean']:.6f}")
